title: Media Profiles: Resize and Crop Images Consistently | Orchard Core
description:
A picture in the Media Library keeps its own size, but a site needs it wide for a banner in one place and small for a thumbnail in another. Writing those sizes out page by page makes them hard to keep the same.

Media profiles give each size a name. A profile stores image settings such as a width, a height, a resize mode, a format and a quality, and a theme asks for it by name, so one change reaches every page that uses it.

In this video:
• Why media profiles exist
• The Media Profiles page
• The resize modes: Max, Crop, Pad and Stretch
• Creating a profile
• Changing the banner profile and seeing it on the site
• Searching for and deleting profiles
